mechanism: Ketorolac (NSAID) reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, impairing ceftazidime elimination and increasing nephrotoxicity risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or dehydration.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesia if possible or dose adjustment of ceftazidime based on renal function; avoid prolonged concurrent use.
